objections.text: The hand-derived fixed cases already test a lowercase province code joining 'US' under CI_AS and a province code with a trailing space joining 'US'. Additional mixed-case spellings and combining case with the trailing space attack the same two join mechanisms.
objections.resolution: A01 now uses non-ASCII Latin-1 and Greek case pairs and puts the combined case/trailing-space variant on the country side, exercising Unicode folding and asymmetric trimming paths absent from the hand-derived inputs.

objections.text: A07 sends negative SalesYTD and SalesLastYear values and a zero SalesQuota. Those values violate the source SalesPerson nonnegative/positive check constraints, so the money-extremes input is outside the source schema preconditions.
objections.resolution: A07 now sends only nonnegative sales values and a positive or NULL quota. The large and half-unit money values retain the mapping attack while satisfying the SalesPerson checks.

objections.text: A09 inserts the identical PersonPhone primary-key tuple (BusinessEntityID 1, PhoneNumber '555-0100', PhoneNumberTypeID 1) twice. The duplicate fan-out cannot occur under the source schema preconditions.
objections.resolution: A09 now sends the same number under two distinct PhoneNumberTypeID values. The PersonPhone keys are valid, and equal type names still create identical projected rows.
